rule: Passages of quoted Wikipedia text that this site does not repeat (wtl/redact.py). Each is kept here only as the SHA-256 of its exact text and its length in characters, so this file does not repeat it either; a passage of that length whose hash matches is replaced by a 'redacted' tag with its reason, and the rest of the quoted text stays. Editor links and IP addresses are redacted automatically and are not listed here.
